<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 0.1.0-alpha.2 -->

## What's Changed
### Other Changes
* feat(ios): enable game mode support by @colorcard in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/2
* Dev by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/3
* [Codex & IDA Pro MCP] 对于yuzuex.dll的一些逆向工作 by @colorcard in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/5
* Plugin Tracer logger implemented by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/6
* Dev by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/9
* Godot 重构 by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/15
* fix: resolve all compiler warnings by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/12
* Add high-performance Web platform build by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/17
* Use native dialogs for file and error prompts by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/18
* Codex/krkrsdl3 precise behavior by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/21
* Update Godot Engine to 4.7 and godot-cpp to 10.0.0-rc1 by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/22
* Update issue templates by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/27
* fix: q save and termination bug by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/28
* Codex/UI i18n license polish by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/33
* fix: improve Android storage and runtime performance by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/34
* Android bugfixes & Refactored debug system by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/35
* feat: bundle AetherKiri KAG3 demo by @JasmineLCY in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/38
* Verify/Patch some games by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/37
* Fix cross-game runtime and rendering compatibility by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/43
* Integrate optional private E-mote and Live2D runtime package by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/44
* Remove obsolete vcpkg workflows and standardize artifact names by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/41
* Linux support & Small fixes  by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/42
* fix: harden KAG patch and font compatibility by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/47
* Clean-up and enhancement of #46, support DrawDeviceD2Dm RPG title エッチで一途なド田舎兄さまと、古式ゆかしい病弱妹 by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/48
* Update docs in AetherInternal by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/49
* fix(tjs2): load structured ns0 dictionary data by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/50
* Clean-up of legacy resources by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/51
* build(deps-dev): bump postcss from 8.5.15 to 8.5.23 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/53
* Codex/private runtime compatibility squash by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/55
* 确定各平台最低版本 by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/36
* fix: center startup logos and retain settled title frame by @MadCcc in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/56
* feat: add Aether video library and iOS notices by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/57
* docs: add verified iOS and Linux games by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/67
* Bugfix for #64 & #65 by @yorkyang2333 in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/73
* build(ios): hide private C ABI without runtime obfuscation by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/58

## New Contributors
* @colorcard made their first contribution in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/2
* @KYoiRyi made their first contribution in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/3
* @yorkyang2333 made their first contribution in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/15
* @akitaSummer made their first contribution in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/17
* @JasmineLCY made their first contribution in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/38
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/53
* @MadCcc made their first contribution in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/56

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/commits/0.1.0-alpha.2
